statement: For a complex type(1,2) surface the natural principal polarization on A x Adual is not a genus4 Jacobian; when End(A)=Z and NS(A)=Z[L], every principal polarization on that product is automorphic to it, so the underlying product is not any genus4 Jacobian.
depends_on: Borowka2016 Corollary2(1) pp1540–1541 and Theorems5–6 p1539; elementary integral binary-form classification
notes: First exclusion is Known; generic strengthening is Proved. Excludes this proposed construction only. No conclusion against odd scalar factorizations through larger Jacobians. Complex scope retained; no priority claim.
